# Enhancing Employee Outcomes Through Common Good Human Resource Management: Exploring the Role of Meaningfulness and Thriving

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Ying Lu, Mingqiong Mike Zhang, Miles M. Yang, Teng Li  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Human Resource Management  
**DOI:** [10.1002/hrm.70023](https://doi.org/10.1002/hrm.70023)

**Keywords:** common good HRM, meaningfulness, thriving, employee outcomes, human resource management

## Abstract

Introduces the concept of Common Good HRM and examines how it enhances employee outcomes through the mediating mechanisms of meaningfulness and thriving at work.
